SSC CHSL 2025/2026 Exam Results Announced for 3,515 Candidates

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the 2025/2026 Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL) exam results. A total of 3,515 candidates have been provisionally recommended for Document Verification (DV). Candidates are advised to check their eligibility criteria and attend the subsequent sliding process. The results are available for checking on a roll number-wise basis.
